notes: Single paste sanitization policy for the parsed native path and the web terminal frontend. Line endings normalize to CR first: CRLF and lone LF both become CR, and lone CR is preserved. Then unsafe controls are stripped by code point: C0 controls U+0000..U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, and U+000E..U+001F (keeping tab U+0009; CR and LF are already normalized), DEL U+007F, and C1 controls U+0080..U+009F. Escape (U+001B) is C0 and is stripped, which also defuses an embedded bracketed-paste end marker. When the terminal's bracketed-paste mode is set, the sanitized text is wrapped in ESC[200~ and ESC[201~; otherwise it is sent bare. expected is the exact byte sequence delivered to the PTY, as a UTF-8 JSON string. known_gaps lists consumers whose current implementation is known to diverge; those consumers must fail the contract expectation until the gap is fixed and the entry removed.
